problem: Prove whether variance V alone implies V δD ≥ κ/V for the normalized Turán deficit δD at the first descent index of Poisson-binomial distributions.
debate: Lower bounds on the Turán deficit and discrete log-curvature in Poisson-binomial distributions.
gap: Existing bounds degenerate near the mode when summands accumulate at fixed variance; no purely variance-scaled bound is known.
contribution: Proof that V δD ≥ 1/4 for V ≥ 1, with explicit bounds δk ≥ 1/(4V + |k−D|) and optimal constant 1/4 ≤ κ* ≤ 1/3.
note: Well-posed technical problem with explicit bounds and sharpness result; advance to review.
